purpose: Re-audit the fixed three-local-session research frontier after the terminal contract-liability full-source coverage failure and select at most one economically independent public-data mechanism without inspecting a new provider row, factor value, price, or return.

research_scope.quality_gate: ROE at least 5 percent, positive net profit, positive revenue YoY, and positive profit YoY under the existing point-in-time quarterly-quality policy

prior_terminal_evidence.result: The sole 21,792-call full-source attempt completed but failed the frozen P05 report-period coverage gate at 2.1181 percent versus 30 percent. No final full snapshot, capacity audit, comparison field, price, or return was produced.

candidate_review.reason: The existing restricted-share-unlock contract records that 2024-Q1 and 2025-Q1 prior-revenue normalization fields were nearly absent and the displayed latest revenue was revision-prone. Reopening that field family would violate the recorded no-return rejection.

Transaction amounts can use different currencies and the page pairs them with latest revenue and net profit rather than an immutable announcement-time denominator. Amount normalization would introduce currency and later-revision leakage.

The economic direction is ambiguous and the summary page uses latest net assets and profit. A larger subscription can indicate idle-cash strength or capital-allocation risk, so no single direction is justified before a separate mechanism.

The report is an accounting investment state by reporting period, overlaps existing financial-state mechanisms, and has no predeclared short-horizon direction independent of valuation and market conditions.

The public page exposes both first-disclosure and latest-announcement fields in a current latest-state snapshot. Positive and negative deal states cannot be separated without a point-in-time version contract, and a generic activity direction is ambiguous.

No count-complete, structured, common Shanghai-Shenzhen historical source with uniform disclosure timing was located in the inspected public datacenter pages. Notice text scraping is not accepted as a substitute.

Same-issuer same-notice-date clustering of unique related-party transaction records measures governance and related-party disclosure complexity without transaction amounts, counterparties, current financial denominators, prices, or returns. The lower-clustering direction is specified before provider rows and must later survive explicit generic-event-count overlap gates.

selected_mechanism.economic_mechanism: Among quality-eligible issuers, fewer distinct related-party transaction records disclosed on the same announcement date may indicate lower related-party governance complexity and less concentrated disclosure overhang during the next three sessions.
selected_mechanism.raw_measure: related_party_transaction_count = count of unique complete EID values for one supported instrument and one NOTICE_DATE
selected_mechanism.units: inverse unique related-party transaction records per issuer notice date
selected_mechanism.valid_event: SECURITY_CODE is a supported complete six-digit main-board or ChiNext code, NOTICE_DATE is a strict date inside the requested partition, and EID is complete; duplicate instrument/NOTICE_DATE/EID keys abort rather than deduplicate
selected_mechanism.invalid_event_policy: exclude complete unsupported-board codes and count them; abort on missing or malformed keys, duplicate event identities, out-of-partition dates, pagination mismatch, or schema change; never fill, infer, clip, or substitute another field
selected_mechanism.availability: first local trading session strictly after NOTICE_DATE
selected_mechanism.absent_event_policy: missing; never zero activity, infinite sparsity, or a favorable score

mechanism_independence.versus_pledge_and_holder_events: Share-pledge and major-holder mechanisms measure financing collateral or disclosed ownership changes. The candidate counts only related-party transaction records and uses the predeclared lower-clustering direction, but their event-count fields remain mandatory semantic near neighbors.
mechanism_independence.versus_institutional_surveys_and_analyst: Survey and rating counts measure external attention. Related-party disclosures concern issuer transactions with affiliated parties; no participant, analyst, broker, or forecast field is used.
mechanism_independence.versus_insider_and_block_trades: Insider open-market and block-trade factors measure actual security transactions. This candidate excludes trade prices, amounts, holdings, security-market directions, and counterparties.
mechanism_independence.versus_financial_state_and_quality: No revenue, profit, ROE, asset, liability, valuation, market capitalization, or growth value enters the factor. Quarterly quality remains eligibility only.
mechanism_independence.versus_price_volume_and_level2: No OHLCV, VWAP, turnover, order classification, queue, depth, price, or return field enters source acceptance or factor construction.

fixed_sparse_uniqueness_framework.scope: This framework is frozen only for this new independent sparse hypothesis and cannot reopen or reinterpret any terminal branch.
fixed_sparse_uniqueness_framework.semantic_gate: Every named sparse event near neighbor must receive an explicit mechanism comparison and source-overlap accounting before any return access.
fixed_sparse_uniqueness_framework.statistical_gate_when_overlap_is_suffici: For every named sparse near neighbor with at least 100 eligible pairwise sessions and at least 6 pairwise names per session, require absolute median daily Spearman rank correlation below 0.8.
fixed_sparse_uniqueness_framework.insufficient_overlap_policy: Report descriptive overlap and correlation when calculable; insufficient overlap is not statistical synonym evidence, but the semantic gate remains mandatory and may reject a generic event-count clone.
fixed_sparse_uniqueness_framework.size_liquidity_gate: Each dense size or liquidity confounder must provide at least 100 eligible pairwise sessions with at least 50 names and absolute median daily Spearman rank correlation below 0.8.
fixed_sparse_uniqueness_framework.anti_cherry_pick_rule: The catalogs, thresholds, direction, formula, event age, universe, and quality rule cannot change after any related-party provider row or factor value is observed.

required_gate_order: freeze the exact source report, three-field request whitelist, fixed sample windows, pagination and schema rules, formula, direction, timing, invalid-row policy, acceptance thresholds, future capacity, and uniqueness framework before any provider row
implement and locally test count-complete pagination, exact-field normalization, duplicate rejection, universe filtering, cross-section variation checks, one-shot guards, and atomic publication
run exactly one no-price source acceptance over the three frozen historical sample windows and permanently consume it
if and only if acceptance passes, freeze a separate full-source and no-return audit preregistration before a 2019-2025 snapshot
run a no-price 200-cohort, five-year capacity gate before loading any comparison field
only after capacity passes, run the predeclared sparse semantic/statistical and size-liquidity uniqueness gates without forward returns
freeze a separate one-time return and execution diagnostic only if every no-return gate passes
prohibited_actions: request or persist security names, counterparties, relationships, transaction amount, currency, transaction text, payment method, control flag, current revenue, current net profit, price, market cap, valuation, return, credential, cookie, or retail-session data
derive amount ratios, relationship categories, text sentiment, counterparty concentration, control-party flags, another aggregation, an industry residual, or a combined score after seeing rows
invert to prefer denser disclosure, widen the three-calendar-day age, alter sample windows, lower coverage or variation thresholds, treat absence as zero, or rescue failure with another field
deduplicate repeated EID keys silently, accept incomplete pagination, mix providers, or keep a partial snapshot
read prices or returns, aggregate with terminal factors, current-score, select, size, order, or justify Level-2 before all later no-return gates pass
